paragraphs.text: Akagi River is river on the plane of Kamigawa .

Though much smaller than the mighty Yumegawa River , the Akagi is more centrally located to the known lands, flowing from Lake Kamitaki , crossing the Towabara Plains and running past the kitsune village of Sugi Hayashi and into the Jukai Forest, where it nourishes its wooded lands.
One of the Great Battles of Kamigawa, the Battle of Akagi River took place here, in which general Munetsugu Takeno and a battalion of his troops fought several fierce cedar and magma kami .
